#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>

using namespace std;

const double PI = acos(-1.0);

class FastReader {
    static const int BUFFER_SIZE = 1024;
    char buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
    int pos, size;
    bool ensure() {
        if (pos >= size) {
            pos = 0;
            size = fread(buffer, 1, BUFFER_SIZE, stdin);
            if (size <= 0) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
    char getChar() {
        if (!ensure()) return -1;
        return buffer[pos++];
    }
public:
    FastReader() : pos(0), size(0) {}
    int nextInt() {
        char c = getChar();
        while (c <= 32 && c != -1) c = getChar();
        if (c == -1) return 0; // should not happen
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sign = -1;
            c = getChar();
        }
        int res = 0;
        while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = getChar();
        }
        return res * sign;
    }
};

void fft(vector<double>& a, vector<double>& b, bool inverse) {
    int n = a.size();
    for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int bit = n >> 1;
        for (; (j & bit) != 0; bit >>= 1) {
            j ^= bit;
        }
        j ^= bit;
        if (i < j) {
            swap(a[i], a[j]);
            swap(b[i], b[j]);
        }
    }
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int halfLen = len >> 1;
        double angle = 2 * PI / len;
        if (inverse) angle = -angle;
        double wlenCos = cos(angle);
        double wlenSin = sin(angle);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            double wCos = 1.0;
            double wSin = 0.0;
            for (int j = 0; j < halfLen; j++) {
                double uA = a[i + j];
                double uB = b[i + j];
                double vA = a[i + j + halfLen] * wCos - b[i + j + halfLen] * wSin;
                double vB = a[i + j + halfLen] * wSin + b[i + j + halfLen] * wCos;
                a[i + j] = uA + vA;
                b[i + j] = uB + vB;
                a[i + j + halfLen] = uA - vA;
                b[i + j + halfLen] = uB - vB;
                double newCos = wCos * wlenCos - wSin * wlenSin;
                double newSin = wCos * wlenSin + wSin * wlenCos;
                wCos = newCos;
                wSin = newSin;
            }
        }
    }
    if (inverse) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] /= n;
            b[i] /= n;
        }
    }
}

vector<int> multiplyMod(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int need = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
    int n = 1;
    while (n < need) n <<= 1;
    if (n < 2) n = 2;

    vector<double> aReal(n, 0), aImag(n, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {
        int x = (a[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        aReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
        aImag[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    fft(aReal, aImag, false);

    vector<double> bReal(n, 0), bImag(n, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); i++) {
        int x = (b[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        bReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
        bImag[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    fft(bReal, bImag, false);

    vector<double> faReal(n), faImag(n), fbReal(n), fbImag(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);
        double a1r = (aReal[i] + aReal[j]) / 2;
        double a1i = (aImag[i] - aImag[j]) / 2;
        double a2r = (aImag[i] + aImag[j]) / 2;
        double a2i = (aReal[j] - aReal[i]) / 2;
        double b1r = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) / 2;
        double b1i = (bImag[i] - bImag[j]) / 2;
        double b2r = (bImag[i] + bImag[j]) / 2;
        double b2i = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) / 2;
        faReal[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        faImag[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
        fbReal[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        fbImag[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }

    fft(faReal, faImag, true);
    fft(fbReal, fbImag, true);

    vector<int> res(need);
    for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
        long long aa = (long long)(faReal[i] + 0.5);
        long long bb = (long long)(fbReal[i] + 0.5);
        long long cc = (long long)(faImag[i] + 0.5);
        long long val = aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30);
        res[i] = (int)(val % mod);
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    FastReader in;
    const int mod = 998244353;
    int n = in.nextInt();
    int k = in.nextInt();
    vector<int> v(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int x = in.nextInt();
        v[x] = 1;
    }
    vector<int> ans = {1};
    int p = n / 2;
    while (true) {
        if (p % 2 != 0) {
            ans = multiplyMod(ans, v, mod);
        }
        p /= 2;
        if (p == 0) break;
        v = multiplyMod(v, v, mod);
    }
    long long res = 0;
    for (int x : ans) {
        res = (res + (long long)x * x) % mod;
    }
    printf("%d\n", (int)res);
    return 0;
}
